home.projectTagline: the way to the Father's house

about.title: About
about.body:
Before you ever began to look for God, He had already come to meet you. Discover this in the living Word - guided step by step, a road to the Father's house that you can walk at your own pace.

No accounts, no sign-in, no tracking. Works offline after downloading the language module.
about.privacy: The app collects no user data.

flashcards.title: Memorize Scripture
flashcards.intro: Learn the 50 most important Bible texts by heart. Pick topics and practice with flashcards; texts you don't remember come back for review on the following days.
flashcards.ctaDesc: The 50 most important Bible texts - flashcards with spaced review.
flashcards.sessionDoneDesc: You've finished all reviews planned for today. Come back tomorrow to reinforce.
flashcards.localOnly: Your progress is saved only on this device (in the browser), with no account. Clearing browser data removes it.

occasions.title: Bible verses for every occasion
occasions.intro: Choose an occasion and find fitting passages of Scripture. You can send each one to someone you love.
occasions.ctaDesc: Verses for sadness, joy, fear, sickness and much more - ready to send.
